## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `PolicyAssetNotAllowed` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Check the governance policy allowlist for the asset token before creating a stream; propose adding the asset via the governor.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let admin = Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_init(&admin);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_set_timelock_delay(&0);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_propose_asset(&f.token, &false);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_execute_asset(&f.token);
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_create_stream(
    &f.sender, &f.recipient, &f.token, &DEPOSIT,
    &(now + DAY), &(now + 2 * DAY), &false,
));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
